name: Develop audio processing scripts in Python
description: Users asked to create, modify, or debug Python scripts for various audio processing tasks, including speech recognition, text-to-speech generation, metadata tagging, feature extraction, and format conversion. The requests often involved integrating specific libraries like FFmpeg, Vosk, or Whisper, fixing playback issues, and optimizing code for real-time or batch processing.
